film: this wallet put eighteen thousand two hundred dollars into memes on robinhood chain.
today those memes are worth five cents.
the same dollars in nvda, bought at the same moments, would be worth sixteen thousand seven hundred.
every buy priced with the chainlink round of that moment. measured, not estimated.
this is terra firma. your hindsight, then solid ground: real stock tokens you own.
three ownerless contracts.
a router that trades memes and keeps a slice as stock. a jar that holds it. a fee pool that turns fees into burned wif and stock for stakers.
everything next is real, on robinhood chain mainnet, from my own wallet.
i connect.
first, i buy a meme like anyone would. a few cents of eth, through uniswap.
my card shows what i paid, what it's worth, and what it would be in nvda.
this meme is going nowhere. so i convert it.
one confirmation. the meme is sold, and real nvda lands in my jar.
no admin key. i can take my stock out any time.
but you don't have to stop trading memes. you just keep a slice.
i buy pons with two percent to my jar. one transaction: the meme, plus a slice of nvda.
and sell it back. buys and sells, on every kind of uniswap pool here.
every trade pays a half percent fee. that's where wif comes in.
i buy wif and stake it. stakers pick a stock. mine is nvda.
stake ten thousand and your fee drops to point three percent.
every epoch the fee pool splits. half buys wif and burns it. half buys stock for stakers.
anyone can run it. i press run distribute.
wif bought and burned, and the burn checks out three separate ways.
the other half is waiting for me. i claim it, into my jar as nvda.
last, i mint my card. it burns one wif, after the contract recomputes it from chainlink.
it's on the leaderboard now. biggest regrets, biggest jars.
don't trust me. every transaction you just watched is on the proof page.
and the contract itself can price any card, so you can check my numbers.
who is it for? anyone on robinhood chain holding memes they know the ending of.
wif holders. every trade buys wif, burns wif, and pays stakers in stock.
and traders who won't stop. let every trade leave a little stock behind.
what it doesn't promise: it covers tracked memes and eth, usdg or stock buys. the rest shows as unpriced.
it's not profit and loss. and it's unaudited, so keep it small.
that's terra firma. stand on wif. sweep the rest into stock.
